summary: Completed comprehensive testing of RC-01 through RC-09 bug fixes for Rahaza Travel Fleet Management ERP. All 7 critical bug fixes (RC-01 to RC-07) verified working correctly via backend API tests. CORS hygiene (RC-08) and session TTL (RC-09) confirmed functional. Frontend smoke test passed - login, dashboard, and bookings list all working with payment_status displaying correctly. All tests passed with 100% success rate.

RC-03: Trip status becomes 'completed', vehicle freed to 'available', booking completed

RC-04: Vehicle status correctly updated after booking cancellation

RC-01_race_overpayment.verification: Atomic find_one_and_update with $expr guard prevents overpayment. First payment 800k accepted, second 800k rejected with 'melebihi sisa tagihan' error. paid_amount correctly limited to total_amount.

RC-02_payment_status_honesty.verification: Completed booking without payment shows payment_status='belum_bayar' (not 'selesai'). Appears in AR with outstanding amount. Fully paid booking shows 'lunas'. Financial signal is honest.

RC-03_split_brain_trip.verification: Trip completion via /trips/{id}/status calls finalize_trip_completion (SSOT). Same effects as driver checkout: trip completed, vehicle freed, booking completed, distance_km calculated.

RC-04_cancel_resource_sync.verification: Cancelling booking triggers _release_booking_resources. Related trip cancelled, vehicle freed to 'available' (when no other active trip), driver set offline.

RC-05_payment_to_cancelled.verification: Payment to cancelled booking rejected with 400 status and error message 'Booking dibatalkan — pembayaran ditolak'.

RC-06_payroll_overlap.verification: Overlapping payroll periods detected using $lte and $gte. First period 2028-06-01 to 2028-06-30 succeeds. Overlapping period 2028-06-15 to 2028-07-15 rejected with 'tumpang-tindih' error. Non-overlapping period 2028-07-01 to 2028-07-31 succeeds.

RC-07_driver_double_assign.verification: find_driver_conflicts checks for overlapping bookings by driver. Same driver assigned to booking1 succeeds. Attempt to assign same driver to overlapping booking2 (different vehicle) rejected with 400 'Driver bentrok' error.

RC-08_cors_hygiene.verification: CORS configured correctly. OPTIONS request succeeds with CORS headers. Backend uses Bearer auth (not cookies). allow_credentials disabled when origin='*' for spec compliance.

RC-09_session_ttl.verification: Login returns valid token. /auth/me works with token. TTL index on sessions.expires_dt ensures automatic cleanup.

notes: All 7 critical bug fixes (RC-01 to RC-07) verified working correctly
Backend runs single-worker uvicorn so RC-01 race won't literally race, but atomic guard ensures invariant holds
Used far-future dates (2028) for test bookings to avoid clashing with seed data
Vehicle status may legitimately stay 'on_trip' if seed trip uses it - only flagged if NO active trip references it
Anti-double-booking (INV-4) working correctly - prevented vehicle conflicts during testing
Frontend displays payment_status correctly with color-coded badges: Lunas (green), Belum Bayar (red), DP (yellow)
Dashboard shows correct KPIs including Piutang (AR) of Rp 19,450,000
All demo accounts working: owner@demo.local, ops@demo.local, driver@demo.local (password: demo12345)
